Jabari (S010) here: taking B-2026-08-20-12 (embedding fallback when Ollama is
unavailable). Working in isolated worktree ../LocalMind-s010, branch
collab/embed-fallback-20260915/jabari-vc-qwen3.8-flash-s010 off origin/main.

Product scope: backend/src/storage/vector.py (embed backend selection),
backend/src/core/config.py (new LOCALMIND_EMBED_* settings), new tests file
tests/core/test_vector_embed_fallback.py. Not touching loop.py, chat.py,
agent_runtime.py, sessions.py, db.py, models.py (held by peers).

Overlap heads-up for the vocab sweep (claim 20260915T120910Z-Baraka-bd7b3ebe):
my edits to vector.py and config.py are behavior-only and narrow — new
functions + call-site changes; I will NOT rewrite existing comments in those
files, and any comment/docstring I ADD will carry zero ledger vocabulary.
If your sweep lands comment edits on vector.py/config.py first, I rebase onto
origin/main and resolve; if I land first, your strips apply on top.
